name: Heroic
description:
This one takes a little luck. You'll have to find Steadfast drones in chests classified as dungeon chests. Note that doesn't mean the chests have to be in a dungeon! You could find one in the middle of some Thaumcraft obsidian pillars right on the surface of The Overworld. 

Heroic bees have the pleasant effect of causing damage to hostile mobs. Breed them from Steadfast and Valiant.

[note]Breeder's Notes:

Specifically, you'll only ever find Steadfast drones in the chests. §nNo princesses.§r You'll have to convert a princess if you want to make a stock of them. Heroic is the only thing you can use them for, but you'll have a better time of it if you have more than a handful of drones. So if you play your cards well and use a high-fertility starter princess, you could take one or two Steadfast drones and multiply them into something safer before trying this mutation.[/note]
